name: Agentic Tool-Use & Structured Output (Hermes)
description: Function-calling in Hermes <tool_call> format, with categories following the Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard: simple, tool selection among distractors, parallel and parallel-multiple calls, argument precision, and relevance detection (correctly declining to call when no tool fits or a required argument is missing). Graded by parsing each emitted tool call as JSON and matching its arguments individually, so a correct tool name with wrong arguments fails. Original scenarios; tune the <tools> block to your own schema.

prompts.title: Simple call with required args
prompts.description: One tool, both required arguments must be correct.

messages.content:
You are a function-calling AI model. You are provided with function signatures within <tools></tools> XML tags. Call the appropriate function(s) to satisfy the user query. For each call, return a JSON object with the function name and arguments within <tool_call></tool_call> tags as: <tool_call>{"name": "<name>", "arguments": <args-dict>}</tool_call>. Use only the arguments defined in the schema, and follow every stated format exactly. If no provided function is relevant to the query, or if a required argument is missing from the query, do NOT call any function — reply in plain text instead.
<tools>
[{"name": "get_weather", "description": "Get the current weather for a location.", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"location": {"type": "string", "description": "City name"}, "unit": {"type": "string", "enum": ["celsius", "fahrenheit"]}}, "required": ["location", "unit"]}}]
</tools>
What is the temperature in Paris right now? Use celsius.
